36200.grammar: aor of na deti, neg, trans (+acc)
36200.meaning1: did not give; did not offer (to)

examples.text: yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃcitto kulāni upasaṅkamati, dentu'y'eva me, mā n'ādaṃsu, bahukaññ'eva me dentu, mā thokaṃ, paṇītaññ'eva me dentu, mā lūkhaṃ, sīghaññ'eva me dentu, mā dandhaṃ, sakkaccaññ'eva me dentu, mā asakkaccan'ti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nādike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo gosiṅgasālavanadāye viharanti.

36202.grammar: pp of na dadāti, neg x2

examples.text: adinn'ādānaṃ pahāya adinn'ādānā paṭivirato hoti. yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ, gāmagataṃ vā araññagataṃ vā, taṃ n'ādinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātā hoti.

36203.grammar: pp of na dadāti, neg x2

examples.text: dinnaṃ sukhaphalaṃ hoti, n'ādinnaṃ hoti taṃ tathā, corā haranti rājāno, aggi ḍahati nassati.

36204.meaning1: not fundamental to the holy life; not essential to the spiritual path
36204.construction:
na + ādi + brahma + cariya + ka
nādibrahmacariya + ka

examples.text: kasmā pan'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā abyākatan'ti? na h'etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, atthasaṃhitaṃ na dhammasaṃhitaṃ n'ādibrahmacariyakaṃ
taṃ kissa hetu? n'esā, bhikkhave, kathā atthasaṃhitā n'ādibrahmacariyakā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.

36205.grammar: pr, from na ādiyati, neg, trans (+acc)
36205.meaning1: does not take; does not steal

examples.text: yo'dha dīghaṃ va rassaṃ vā, aṇuṃ thūlaṃ subh'āsubhaṃ, loke adinnaṃ n'ādiyati, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
sace musā na bhaṇasi, sace pāṇaṃ na hiṃsasi, sace adinnaṃ n'ādiyasi, saddahāno amaccharī, kiṃ kāhasi gayaṃ gantvā, udapāno'pi te gayā'ti.

36206.grammar: aor of na ādiyati, neg, trans (+acc)
36206.commentary: (VINa) n'ādiyī'ti tassā vacanaṃ na ādiyi, na gaṇhi, na vā ādaram'akāsī'ti attho.

36207.grammar: pr, from na ādeti, neg, trans (+acc)
36207.meaning1: does not take; does not accept
36207.commentary: (SNPa) n'ādeti na nirassatī'ti rūp'ādīsu kañci dhammaṃ na gaṇhāti, na nissajjati.

examples.text: na samesu na omesu, na ussesu vadate muni, santo so vītamaccharo, n'ādeti na nirassatī'ti.
yo ca dīghaṃ va rassaṃ vā, aṇuṃ thūlaṃ subh'āsubhaṃ, loke adinnaṃ n'ādeti, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

36208.meaning1: has not seen; did not see
36208.construction:
na + a + dakkha + i
na + addakkhi
36208.commentary: (NIDD1) ito ca n'āddakkhi aṇum'pi saññan'ti. ito ajjhattasantito vā paṭipadāto vā dhammadesanāto vā, yuttasaññaṃ pattasaññaṃ lakkhaṇasaññaṃ kāraṇasaññaṃ ṭhānasaññaṃ na paṭilabhati, kuto ñāṇan'ti. evam'pi ito ca n'āddakkhi aṇum'pi saññaṃ. atha vā aniccaṃ vā aniccasaññ'ānulomaṃ vā, dukkhaṃ vā dukkhasaññ'ānulomaṃ vā, anattaṃ vā anattasaññ'ānulomaṃ vā, saññ'uppādamattaṃ vā sañjānitamattaṃ vā na paṭilabhati, kuto ñāṇan'ti. evam'pi ito ca n'āddakkhi aṇum'pi saññaṃ.

examples.text: diṭṭhiñ'ca nissāya anupucchamāno, samuggahītesu pamoham'āgā, ito ca n'āddakkhi aṇum'pi saññaṃ, tasmā tuvaṃ momuhato dahāsi.
taṃ ce hi n'āddakkhuṃ tathāvimuttaṃ, (icc'āyasmā mogharājā) devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, nar'uttamaṃ atthacaraṃ narānaṃ, ye taṃ namassanti pasaṃsiyā te'ti.

36209.construction:
na + a + dasa + a
na + addasa
36209.commentary: (SNPa) n'āddasāsiṃ anositan'ti kiñci ṭhānaṃ jar'ādīhi anajjhāvutthaṃ n'āddakkhiṃ.

examples.text: diṭṭhiñ'ca nissāya anupucchamāno, samuggahītesu pamoham'āgā, ito ca n'āddakkhi aṇum'pi saññaṃ, tasmā tuvaṃ momuhato dahāsi.
samantam'asāro loko, disā sabbā sameritā, icchaṃ bhavanam'attano, n'āddasāsiṃ anositaṃ.

36210.construction:
na + a + dasa + āsi
na + addasāsi
36210.commentary: (NIDD1) n'āddasāsiṃ anositan'ti. ajjhositaṃ'y'eva addasaṃ, anajjhositaṃ n'āddasaṃ, sabbaṃ yobbaññaṃ jarāya ositaṃ, sabbaṃ ārogyaṃ byādhinā ositaṃ, sabbaṃ jīvitaṃ maraṇena ositaṃ, sabbaṃ lābhaṃ alābhena ositaṃ, sabbaṃ yasaṃ ayasena ositaṃ, sabbaṃ pasaṃsaṃ nindāya ositaṃ, sabbaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhena ositaṃ. (SNPa) n'āddasāsiṃ anositan'ti kiñci ṭhānaṃ jar'ādīhi anajjhāvutthaṃ n'āddakkhiṃ.

examples.text: samantam'asāro loko, disā sabbā sameritā, icchaṃ bhavanam'attano, n'āddasāsiṃ anositaṃ.

36211.grammar: aor 1st sg of na addasāsi, neg, trans (+acc)
36211.construction:
na + a + dasa + āsiṃ
na + addasāsiṃ

examples.text: samantam'asāro loko, disā sabbā sameritā, icchaṃ bhavanam'attano, n'āddasāsiṃ anositaṃ.

36212.grammar: masc, from na dhamma, neg x2
36212.meaning1: not against the Dhamma; not something opposed to the teaching

examples.text: subhāsitaṃ uttamam'āhu santo, dhammaṃ bhaṇe n'ādhammaṃ taṃ dutiyaṃ, piyaṃ bhaṇe n'āppiyaṃ taṃ tatiyaṃ, saccaṃ bhaṇe n'ālikaṃ taṃ catutthan'ti.

36213.grammar: pr, from na adhigacchati, neg, trans (+acc)
36213.meaning1: does not get to; does not attain; does not find; does not acquire; does not obtain
36213.construction:
na + adhi + gaccha + ti
na + adhigacchati

examples.text: asāre sāramatino, sāre c'āsāradassino, te sāraṃ n'ādhigacchanti, micchāsaṅkappagocarā.
so attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, kusalañ'ca dhammaṃ n'ādhigacchati, uttari ca manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ na sacchikaroti.

36214.grammar: aor of na adhigacchati, neg, trans (+acc)
36214.meaning1: did not get; did not find
36214.construction:
na + adhi + gaccha + i
na + adhigacchi

examples.text: satta vassāni bhagavantaṃ, anubandhiṃ padāpadaṃ, otāraṃ n'ādhigacchissaṃ, sambuddhassa satīmato.

36215.grammar: aor 1st sg of na adhigacchi, neg, trans (+acc)
36215.meaning1: I did not get; I did not find
36215.construction:
na + adhi + gaccha + issaṃ
na + adhigacchissaṃ

examples.text: satta vassāni bhagavantaṃ, anubandhiṃ padāpadaṃ, otāraṃ n'ādhigacchissaṃ, sambuddhassa satīmato.

36216.grammar: pr, from na adhiṭṭhāti, neg, trans (+acc)
36216.meaning1: does not stand firmly; does not take a stand; does not make up one's mind; does not fixate
36216.construction:
na + adhi + ṭhā + ti
na + adhiṭṭhāti

examples.text: so viññāṇaṃ na upeti, na upādiyati, n'ādhiṭṭhāti, attā me'ti. tass'ime pañc'upādānakkhandhā anupetā anupādinnā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantī'ti.
upay'upādān'ābhinivesa-vinibandho khv'āyaṃ, kaccāna, loko yebhuyyena. tañ'c'āyaṃ upay'upādānaṃ cetaso adhiṭṭhānaṃ abhinives'ānusayaṃ na upeti na upādiyati n'ādhiṭṭhāti, attā me'ti.

36217.grammar: pr, pass of na adhimuñcati, neg, intrans (+loc)
36217.meaning1: is not drawn (to); is not attracted (to); does not incline (towards)
36217.construction:
na + adhi + mucca + ti
na + adhimuccati

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, olīyanti eke? bhav'ārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā bhavaratā bhavasammuditā tesaṃ bhavanirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati n'ādhimuccati.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, saṃvaro hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe n'ādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso

36218.grammar: pr, pass of na adhimuñcati, neg, intrans (+loc)
36218.meaning1: does not draw a definite conclusion; is not resolved (about)
36218.construction:
na + adhi + mucca + ti
na + adhimuccati

examples.text: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati, kos'ohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya ca.
yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.

36219.meaning1: not infatuated; not greedy; not strongly fixated on
36219.commentary: (THa) n'ādhimucchitā na ajjhositā akkhabbhañjanaṃ viya sākaṭikā, vaṇalepanaṃ viya vaṇino abhuñjiṃsu.

examples.text: paṇītaṃ yadi vā lūkhaṃ, appaṃ vā yadi vā bahuṃ, yāpan'atthaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, agiddhā n'ādhimucchitā.

36220.grammar: pr, caus of na adhivasati, neg, trans (+acc)
36220.meaning1: does not tolerate; does not accept; does not endure
36220.meaningLit: does not cause to live through
36220.construction:
na + adhi + vāse + ti
na + adhivāseti

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ n'ādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti
passatha no tumhe taṃ vacanapathaṃ, aṇuṃ vā thūlaṃ vā, yaṃ tumhe n'ādhivāseyyāthā'ti?

36221.grammar: pr, from na adhīyati, neg, intrans
36221.meaning1: does not learn by heart; does not recite
36221.construction:
na + adhi + iya + ti
na + adhīyati
36221.commentary: (SNa) n'ādhīyasī'ti na sajjhāyasi. n'ādiyasī'ti vā pāṭho, na gaṇhāsī'ti attho.

examples.text: kasmā tuvaṃ dhammapadāni bhikkhu, n'ādhīyasi bhikkhūhi saṃvasanto, sutvāna dhammaṃ labhatippasādaṃ, diṭṭh'eva dhamme labhatippasaṃsan'ti.

36222.meaning2: (kamma) acting from a different or earlier moment of time

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo rājānaṃ vā rājamah'āmattaṃ vā nānaccayehi sūpehi paccupaṭṭhito assa.
kim'ārammaṇā, samiddhi, purisassa saṅkappavitakkā uppajjantī'ti? nāmarūp'ārammaṇā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kva nānattaṃ gacchantī'ti? dhātūsu, bhante'ti.

evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā y'āyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā, y'āyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lok'āmis'ūpādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tam'ev'ūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.
atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā, atthi upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā. katamā ca, bhikkhave, upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā?

evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā y'āyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā, y'āyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lok'āmis'ūpādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tam'ev'ūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.

36227.meaning1: chatting about this and that; talk about various topics

examples.text: nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lok'akkhāyikaṃ samudd'akkhāyikaṃ itibhav'ābhavakathaṃ iti vāti

36228.meaning1: having a variety of bodily states; physically diverse
36228.meaning2: having a variety of bodily states
36228.commentary: (DNa) ye'pi hi katthaci yamakabhātaro vaṇṇena vā saṇṭhānena vā ekasadisā honti, tesam'pi ālokita-vilokita-kathita-hasita-gamana-ṭhān'ādīhi viseso hoti'y'eva. tasmā nānattakāyā'ti vuttā.

examples.text: sant'ānanda, sattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino, seyyathā'pi devā brahmakāyikā paṭham'ābhinibbattā. ayaṃ dutiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.

36230.meaning1: recognition of diversity; perception of multiplicity; concept of variety
36230.commentary: (MNa) nānattasaññā'ti mayhaṃ ekajātikaṃ rūpaṃ manasikarontassa abhijappā uppannā, nānāvidharūpaṃ manasi karissāmī'ti kālena devalok'ābhimukhaṃ kālena manussalok'ābhimukhaṃ vaḍḍhetvā nānāvidhāni rūpāni manasikaroto nānattasaññā udapādi.

examples.text: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā, ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma

yā vā pan'etāsaṃ saññānaṃ parisuddhā paramā aggā anuttariyā akkhāyati, yadi rūpasaññānaṃ yadi arūpasaññānaṃ yadi ekattasaññānaṃ yadi nānattasaññānaṃ. n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanam'eke abhivadanti appamāṇaṃ āneñjaṃ.

36231.meaning1: due to the concept of diversity; because of the perception of multiplicity

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, anuruddhā, etadahosi, nānattasaññā kho me udapādi, nānattasaññ'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi. samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ.

36232.meaning1: having diverse perception; with different conceptions
36232.commentary: (ANa) paṭisandhisaññā pana nesaṃ tihetukā'pi dvihetukā'pi ahetukā'pi hoti. tasmā nānattasaññino'ti vuttā.

examples.text: ekattasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti arogaṃ paraṃ maraṇā, nānattasaññiṃ vā te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti arogaṃ paraṃ maraṇā
atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā, atthi upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā. katamā ca, bhikkhave, upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā?

evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā y'āyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā, y'āyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lok'āmis'ūpādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tam'ev'ūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.

36234.meaning2: Chapter 1 of the Dhātusaṃyuttaṃ, Book 2 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

36235.meaning1: having a variety of colours; with diverse forms

examples.text: majjhe sarassa tiṭṭhanti, vimānā kappaṭṭhāyino, veḷuriyavaṇṇā rucirā, accimanto pabhassarā, accharā tattha naccanti, puthu nānattavaṇṇiyo.

36236.meaning1: having a variety of colours; with diverse appearances

examples.text: chasahassā hemavatā, yakkhā nānattavaṇṇino, iddhimanto jutīmanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, modamānā abhikkāmuṃ, bhikkhūnaṃ samitiṃ vanaṃ.

36237.meaning1: different in meaning; having a distinct sense
36237.commentary: (MNa) nān'atthā c'eva nānābyañjanā cā'ti byañjanam'pi nesaṃ nānā attho'pi.

examples.text: yā c'āyaṃ, gahapati, appamāṇā cetovimutti yā ca mahaggatā cetovimutti ime dhammā nān'atthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca. tadaminā'p'etaṃ, gahapati, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā ime dhammā nān'atthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca.

36238.meaning2: grasping the various meanings and letters

36241.meaning1: perceiving (someone) as on different sheets and under different covers

36242.meaning2: state of having various inclinations or intents

36243.grammar: adj, from na antavant, neg x2

examples.text: antavā ca anantavā ca attā ca loko ca, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti, itth'eke abhivadanti, n'ev'antavā n'ānantavā attā ca loko ca, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti, itth'eke abhivadanti

36244.meaning1: various; many different kinds of; manifold

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imam'eva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati
tvaṃ attano vīriyaṃ daḷhaṃ katvā paggaṇhāti bodhisattaṃ nānappakārāhi thutīhi abhitthuniṃsu.

36245.meaning1: various; many different kinds of; manifold
36245.commentary: (VIN 1.4.2.9) nānappakārakaṃ nāma katam'pi akatam'pi kat'ākatam'pi. kataṃ nāma sīs'ūpagaṃ gīv'ūpagaṃ hatth'ūpagaṃ pād'ūpagaṃ kaṭ'ūpagaṃ. akataṃ nāma ghanakataṃ vuccati. kat'ākataṃ nāma tadubhayaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ kayavikkayaṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu parivīmaṃsamāno parivīmaṃsati, yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ, idaṃ nu kho dukkhaṃ kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ?
avipariṇāmadhammo'ti attano pakatibhāvaṃ avijahanadhammo, kakaṇṭako viya nānappakārataṃ n'āpajjati.

36247.meaning1: having many different kinds of elements

36248.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of nānappakāra
36248.meaning1: in various ways; in different ways

examples.text: tasmiṃ samaye bārāṇasivāsino devatāmaṅgalikā honti, devatā namassanti, bahū aj'eḷakakukkuṭasūkar'ādayo vadhitvā nānappakārehi pupphagandhehi c'eva maṃsalohitehi ca balikammaṃ karonti

36249.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of nāna

examples.text: yā c'āyaṃ, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti, yā ca suññatā cetovimutti, yā ca animittā cetovimutti, atthi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca, atthi ca kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ek'atthā, byañjanam'eva nānaṃ.

36250.meaning2: is separated; is different, is distinct

examples.text: nānā hi kho no, bhante, kāyā ekañ'ca pana maññe cittan'ti
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso chappāṇake gahetvā nānāvisaye nānāgocare daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya.
sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiparibbasānā, viggayha nānā kusalā vadanti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ, idaṃ paṭikkosam'akevalī so.
tasmā satañ'ca asataṃ nānā hoti ito gati, asanto nirayaṃ yanti, santo saggaparāyanā'ti.
ekakulassa nivesanaṃ hoti parikkhittañ'ca, nānāgabbhā nānāovarakā. antonivesane cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā antonivesane vatthabbaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅghaṭṭanasamodhānā usmā jāyati tejo abhinibbattati. tesaṃ'y'eva dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ nānākatavinibbhogā yā tajjā usmā sā nirujjhati sā vūpasammati. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sukhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhavedanā.
tatra, bhikkhave, ko viseso ko adhippayāso kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenā'ti?
idha no, āvuso, ko viseso, ko adhippayāso, kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā, yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ, anusāsaniyā vā anusāsanin'ti?

36260.meaning1: various corpses; variety of disgusting things

examples.text: dvipādako'yaṃ asuci, duggandho parihīrati, nānākuṇapaparipūro, vissavanto tato tato.

36261.meaning1: scented with the odour of various corpses and pervaded with draughts
36261.sanskrit: nānā + kuṇapa + gandha + vāsita + pavana + vicarita

examples.text: kathaṃ aparipakkato? so pan'āyam'āhāro evarūpe okāse nidhānam'upagato yāva aparipakko hoti, tāva tasmiññ'eva yathāvuttappakāre paramandhakāratimise nānākuṇapa-gandhavāsita-pavanavicarite atiduggandhajegucche padese

36262.meaning1: of different families; from various households

examples.text: tumhe khv'attha, vāseṭṭha, nānājaccā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānākulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā. ke tumhe'ti, puṭṭhā samānā samaṇā sakyaputtiy'āmhā'ti, paṭijānātha.

36263.meaning1: various types of sweets and pastries

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, purisassa ucchaṅge nānākhajjakāni ākiṇṇāni, tilā taṇḍulā modakā badarā. so tamhā āsanā vuṭṭhahanto satisammosā pakireyya.

36264.meaning1: accepting different beliefs; agreeing with other views
36264.meaning2: holding various or different preferred views
36264.commentary: (UDa) sassat'ādi-vaseneva khamanaṃ khanti, rocanaṃ ruci, atthato sassato attā ca loko cā'ti-ādinā (udā. 55) pavatto cittavipallāso saññāvipallāso ca. tathā nānā khantiyo etesan'ti nānākhantikā, nānā ruciyo etesan'ti nānārucikā.

examples.text: idha, bhante, sambahulā nānātitthiya-samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti nānādiṭṭhikā nānākhantikā nānārucikā nānādiṭṭhinissayanissitā.

tattha yo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vāsaṃ upeti, ten'āhaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajāmi. bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, cattāro satthāro nānādiṭṭhikā nānākhantikā nānārucikā, tasmiṃ āvasathāgāre vāsaṃ upagacchuṃ.
ekakulassa nivesanaṃ hoti parikkhittañ'ca, nānāgabbhā nānā-ovarakā. antonivesane cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā antonivesane vatthabbaṃ.

36266.meaning1: with different feeding grounds; with various pastures

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso chappāṇake gahetvā nānāvisaye nānāgocare daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya.

36267.meaning1: with different domains; with different ranges

examples.text: pañc'imāni, āvuso, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, sot'indriyaṃ, ghān'indriyaṃ, jivh'indriyaṃ, kāy'indriyaṃ.
pañc'imāni, bho gotama, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti.

36268.meaning1: of different clans; belonging to various families

examples.text: tumhe khv'attha, vāseṭṭha, nānājaccā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānākulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā. ke tumhe'ti, puṭṭhā samānā samaṇā sakyaputtiy'āmhā'ti, paṭijānātha.

yathā taṃ suttena asaṅgahitattā. evam'eva kho, sāriputta, tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ antaradhānena buddh'ānubuddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā te taṃ brahmacariyaṃ khippaññ'eva antaradhāpesuṃ.

36271.meaning1: of various births; of different castes

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, assalāyana, idha rājā khattiyo muddh'āvasitto nānājaccānaṃ purisānaṃ purisasataṃ sannipāteyya

36272.meaning1: many people; various people; different nationalities

examples.text: nānājanā janapadehi saṅgatā, tava vīra vākyaṃ abhikaṅkhamānā, tesaṃ tuvaṃ sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.

36273.meaning1: various countries; different parts of the land
36273.meaning2: various countries; different parts of the land

examples.text: nānākulā pabbajitā, nānājanapadehi ca, aññam'aññaṃ piyāyanti, tena me samaṇā piyā.

36274.meaning1: belonging to various sects; of different schools

examples.text: evaṃ vutte purimāni, bhante, divasāni purimatarāni, nānātitthiyānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ kotūhalasālāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ abhisaññānirodhe kathā udapādi, kathaṃ nu kho, bho, abhisaññānirodho hotī'ti?

36275.meaningLit: discourse with followers of various sects

36276.meaning1: followers of various sects; disciples of different religions
36276.construction:
nānā + titthiya + sāvaka + ā
nānātitthiyasāvaka + ā

examples.text: atha kho sambahulā nānātitthiyasāvakā devaputtā asamo ca sahali ca nīko ca ākoṭako ca vegabbhari ca māṇavagāmiyo ca abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ veḷuvanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu

36277.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Devaputtasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 1 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

36278.meaning1: heads of various religious sects; teachers of different schools
36278.commentary: (SNa) nānātitthiye'ti so kira nānātitthiyānaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāko, tasmā te ārabbha vadati.

examples.text: atha kho ākoṭako devaputto nānātitthiye ārabbha bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

36279.meaning1: different in meaning; having a distinct sense

examples.text: yā c'āyaṃ, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti, yā ca suññatā cetovimutti, yā ca animittā cetovimutti, ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca udāhu ek'atthā byañjanam'eva nānan'ti?
atthi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca, atthi ca kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ek'atthā, byañjanam'eva nānaṃ.

36280.meaning1: various timbers; different kinds of wood

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, siyā nu kho tesaṃ aggīnaṃ nānādāruto abhinibbattānaṃ kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ acciyā vā acciṃ, vaṇṇena vā vaṇṇaṃ, ābhāya vā ābhanti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

36281.meaning1: having different views; holding different beliefs
36281.meaning2: holding various (false) views or theories; holding different views
36281.commentary: (UDa) sassato attā ca loko cā'ti-ādinā passanti etāya, sayaṃ vā passati, tathā dassanamattameva vā'ti diṭṭhi, micch'ābhinivesass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. sassat'ādi-vasena nānā anekavidhā diṭṭhiyo etesan'ti nānādiṭṭhikā.

examples.text: tattha yo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vāsaṃ upeti, ten'āhaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajāmi. bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, cattāro satthāro nānādiṭṭhikā nānākhantikā nānārucikā, tasmiṃ āvasathāgāre vāsaṃ upagacchuṃ.
idha, bhante, sambahulā nānātitthiya-samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti nānādiṭṭhikā nānākhantikā nānārucikā nānādiṭṭhinissayanissitā.

36282.commentary: (VISMa) nānādisāyaṃ patitampī'ti chinnaṃ hutvā sarīrassa khaṇḍadvayaṃ visuṃ disāsu patitam'pi.

examples.text: ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhep'attho, sakuṇā nāma asukasmiṃ padese rukkho paripakkaphalo'ti ñatvā nānādisāhi āgantvā nakhapattatuṇḍ'ādīhi tassa phalāni vijjhantā vidhunantā khādanti.

araññe vā pana sīhabyagghehi chinnapurisaṭṭhāne labbhati. tasmā tathārūpaṃ ṭhānaṃ gantvā sace nānādisāyaṃ patitam'pi ekāvajjanena āpātham'āgacchati icc'etaṃ kusalaṃ. no ce āgacchati, sayaṃ hatthena na parāmasitabbaṃ.

36283.meaning1: with many states; with different of elements

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato anekadhātuṃ nānādhātuṃ lokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

36284.meaning1: penetration of the various states; breakthrough of understanding into the many states
36284.commentary: (ANa) nānādhātupaṭivedho'ti ettha imā'va aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo nānāsabhāvato nānādhātuyo'ti veditabbā. yo pan'etāsaṃ nānāsabhāvā etā'ti evaṃ nānākaraṇato paṭivedho, ayaṃ nānādhātupaṭivedho nāma.

examples.text: ekapuggalassa, bhikkhave, pātubhāvā… catunnaṃ paṭisambhidānaṃ sacchikiriyā hoti, anekadhātupaṭivedho hoti, nānādhātupaṭivedho hoti, vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyā hoti, sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyā hoti, sakadāgāmiphala-sacchikiriyā hoti, anāgāmiphala-sacchikiriyā hoti, arahattaphala-sacchikiriyā hoti.

36286.meaning1: knowledge of the fact of having a various dispositions; understanding of the fact of having different inclinations

36287.meaning1: fact of having various dispositions; fact of having different inclinations; fact of having multiple propensities

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato sattānaṃ nān'ādhimuttikataṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

36288.meaning1: fact of having a various dispositions; fact of having different inclinations; fact of having a multiple propensities

examples.text: tumhe khv'attha, vāseṭṭha, nānājaccā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānākulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā. ke tumhe'ti, puṭṭhā samānā samaṇā sakyaputtiy'āmhā'ti, paṭijānātha.

evam'eva kho, sāriputta, tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ antaradhānena buddh'ānubuddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā te taṃ brahmacariyaṃ khippaññ'eva antaradhāpesuṃ.

36295.commentary: (APAa) nānāpupphaṃ samokirin'ti campak'ādīhi anekehi pupphehi samokiriṃ pūjesin'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, nānāpupphānaṃ mahāpuppharāsi, tam'enaṃ dakkho mālākāro vā mālākār'antevāsī vā vicittaṃ mālaṃ gantheyya.
manāpadāyī labhate manāpaṃ, yo ujjubhūtesu dadāti chandasā, acchādanaṃ sayanam'annapānaṃ, nānāppakārāni ca paccayāni.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ samparitāpeyyuṃ, evam'eva kho, āvuso, adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho.
tam'enaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā taṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ. atha kho tassa purisassa ārakā'v'assa cetanā ārakā patthanā ārakā paṇidhi.

36299.meaning1: different in name; distinct in terms of expressions; spelled differently

examples.text: yā c'āyaṃ, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti, yā ca suññatā cetovimutti, yā ca animittā cetovimutti, ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca udāhu ek'atthā byañjanam'eva nānan'ti?
atthi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca, atthi ca kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ek'atthā, byañjanam'eva nānaṃ.
